name: LIHEAP (Energy Assistance)
agency: California Department of Community Services and Development
description: Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program — helps pay for home heating, cooling, and weatherization.

conditions.label: Household has a monthly utility cost
Monthly income at or below 150% FPL for household size

required_docs: Social Security numbers for all household members
deadline: Funds are limited and awarded first-come-first-served each fiscal year. Apply early.
sources: 150% FPL 2025: household of 1 = $1,825/mo, +$635 per additional person (simplified)
